edition.tagline: Protecting Earth from the worst snacks in the universe.
edition.cue: Serve the drinks when Edgar starts demanding sugar water.

s.note: Skillet cornbread straight from the farmhouse oven with honey butter.
s.how: Heat a 25cm cast-iron pan in the oven at 210C. Mix 200g cornmeal, 125g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp sugar, then 350ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter. Pour into the hot greased pan and bake 20 minutes. Cut in wedges with 50g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

s.note: Smoky black bean dip with feta, coriander and corn chips
s.how: Blitz 2 drained tins black beans with 2 garlic cloves, juice of 2 limes, 1 tsp cumin and 1 chipotle in adobo until smooth. Spoon into a bowl and top with 80g crumbled feta and coriander. Serve with corn chips.

m.note: Toasted pastrami and Swiss on rye with mustard and pickles.
m.how: Spread 8 slices rye with deli mustard. Fill 4 with 500g sliced pastrami and 8 slices Swiss cheese, close and toast in a pan with 20g butter over medium heat, 3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts. Cut on the diagonal and serve with pickles.

w.note: Cake pops dipped in white chocolate and brushed silver
w.how: Crumble a 500g butter cake and mix with 100g cream cheese icing until it holds together. Roll into 16 balls, push in sticks and chill an hour. Dip in 300g melted white chocolate, set, then brush with silver lustre dust.

d.note: Very sweet homemade lemonade, the alien favourite
d.how: Make a syrup of 150g caster sugar dissolved in 150ml hot water and cool. Stir with the juice of 4 lemons and 1L cold water. Serve over ice in four glasses with a lemon slice each. Taste and add more syrup if needed.
